5.0.SP2.description: Sub-type qualification/identification of the SecurityType. As an example for SecurityType <167> ="REPO", the SecuritySubType="General Collateral" can be used to further specify the type of REPO. If SecuritySubType is used then SecurityType is required. For SecurityType="MLEG" a name of the option or futures strategy name can be specified, such as "Calendar", "Vertical", "Butterfly".

5.0.SP1.description: Sub-type qualification/identification of the SecurityType <167> (e.g. for SecurityType="REPO"), or the CFICode <461> if SecurityType is not specified. If specified, SecuirtyType or CFICode is required. Example values: General = General Collateral (for SecurityType="REPO") For SecurityType="MLEG" markets can provide the name of the option or futures strategy, such as Calendar, Vertical, Butterfly, etc. NOTE: Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties
